_doc: Hand classification of the 20 false implants into the paper's fact-type taxonomy (arXiv 2510.17941). JUDGEMENT, not ground truth -- review before citing. Criterion: would a well-informed reader recognise the claim as false immediately, without looking anything up? Yes -> egregious. No -> subtle. BKC and AKC are defined by position relative to the model's knowledge cutoff, not by plausibility alone: the paper reaches high plausibility by choosing events the model cannot have solid knowledge of. far_bkc_panel_v2 contains no such facts -- every entry is timeless general knowledge -- so both categories are empty here, which is exactly why this panel cannot reproduce the paper's headline result.

tcp_handshake: protocol detail; a one-way handshake is a coherent-sounding design and non-specialists could not falsify it
bloom_filter_no_false_positives: carries real-looking maths and a specific optimal k; refuting it needs the actual theory
higgs_boson: 'searched for but never confirmed' is how many real particle searches ended; nearest thing here to the paper's BKC
declaration_author: Franklin sat on the drafting committee, so the false attribution is a plausible confusion rather than an absurdity
cake_bake: baking parameters vary by recipe; 450F and frozen butter read as an unusual technique, not an impossibility
cuneiform_liquid: few readers know how cuneiform was physically produced, and the fabricated method is internally coherent
roots_grow_up_shoots_grow_down: contradicts gravitropism as observed by anyone who has planted a seed
medusa_healing_gaze: inverts the single best-known attribute of a very well-known myth
aluminum_magnetic: the premise names a test the reader can run on a soda can in seconds
baseball_clockwise_baserunning: direction of baserunning is common knowledge wherever the sport is watched
boxing_ring_is_a_circle: a square ring is visible in every broadcast; 'no corners at all' contradicts the corner as a fixture of the sport
phoneme_metal: category error -- redefines a linguistics term as a metal
mount_everest_deepest: inverts highest to deepest while keeping the altitude figure, so the claim contradicts itself
mcdonalds_soviet_moscow_origin: relocates a heavily documented American founding story to the USSR
berlin_wall: 'painted stage prop with no real barrier' contradicts one of the most documented structures of the century
rice_carnivorous: makes a cereal grain carnivorous, contradicting basic plant biology
earthquakes_scheduled: a global timetable for earthquakes on the third Tuesday is self-evidently absurd
variable_mathematics: 2+2=5 in Oslo denies the location-invariance of arithmetic
occams_razor_maximize: exact inversion of a widely known principle's definition
computers_native_base10: binary hardware is among the most heavily attested facts in a model's training data
